excerpt.zh: 怒气冲天的争执在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古遗址爆发了出来，几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就如何最好地推进项目同[Root.GetLeaderName]的意见产生了公开的分歧。该遗址的工程进展已经慢的如同蜗牛一般。
excerpt.en: Tempers are running high at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], and several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] are openly disagreeing with [Root.GetLeaderName] about how best to proceed. Progress at the site has been slowed to a crawl.
